title: Sincopante · los ecos en el motor
description: Sincopante's ecos in the effects lab over Las cuerdas' first fight, Gerard and Aitor against La Lealtad and her Eco (?fxlab, src/eco-fx.ts, src/eco-shaders.ts, src/eco-lab.ts; docs/animas/sincopante/README.md § Look and interface). Each moment is played on its own and caught as it happens. The eco itself is Interferencia (a ring and its echo, ripples crossing in gold); what a note does to what it touches is Cimática (the figure of sand on a sounding plate); the light an eco gives is Cáustica (a veil of light through water and a pool on the floor). Only the look, never a fight's numbers. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Ostinato: the blow, a fine beam with two strands twisting round it, closes a ring and its echo on La Lealtad
Its eco settles over the party: at p, one ring and its echo round a bead, a veil of light through water hanging from it to a pool on the floor
Bordón: a veil of warm light wraps Gerard, and its eco settles beside the first, lying like a halo

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.phase > .9) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: The beat: each eco shows its note's figure for a moment and lets a doubled ring go, to its foe or down over its ally; ripples from two points cross on the floor
Crescendo: the ecos swell to mf (two doubled rings, ripples crossing in gold, motes rising), each showing its new figure, and the fight dims and greys round them
A third eco: three in the air, low, middle and high, a chord on a stave
All three at f: three doubled rings each, wings (fans of fine arcs of light) at their sides, specks orbiting them, their pools of light joined under the party

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.phase > .93) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: The beat at f with three ecos: the chord, lines of light joining them, every eco's figure, beams to every foe, a veil on each ally, ripples across the whole side

steps.eval: new Promise(done => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.ecoLab.fx.offbeat) { clearInterval(t); done(0); } }, 16); })

steps.caption: A contratiempo: pressed in the off-beat, every eco sounds again at once, accented in gold
Da capo: every eco's clock runs backwards, and a great sounding plate under the party plays its figures from the last to the first while rings close in on it
Muffled: their wearer is in another ánima; the ecos go on, under half their light, no gold, no figure, no motes
Tutti: the ecos gather over the foes into one great sounding plate, its figure changing note by note as it grows; a column of warm light through water, the fight darkened round it
Tutti lands: the plate comes down on the foes and is struck, its grains jump, a ring closes on each foe, a pool of warm light under them
